scripts.dev: npm run build -w @pil/shared && concurrently -n api,web -c blue,orange "npm run dev -w @pil/api" "npm run dev -w @pil/web"
scripts.build: npm run build -w @pil/shared && npm run build -w @pil/api && npm run build -w @pil/web
scripts.typecheck: npm run build -w @pil/shared && npm run typecheck -w @pil/api && npm run typecheck -w @pil/web
